jobDescription.name: About the Role
jobDescription.value:
This is a fully remote position. Work from anywhere in the United States — remote in all 50 states; no travel or office attendance required.

We are looking for a motivated team member to join our team. You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, and help resolve questions about products and services. This is a full-time position with benefits including health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobDescription.name: Requirements
jobDescription.value: Strong written communication skills and attention to detail are important. Experience with customer support tools is helpful but not required. We provide training and the equipment you need to do the job well.

jobDescription.name: About the Role
jobDescription.value:
This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago office 3 days a week, working from home the other 2 days. You will manage office operations, supplies, and vendor relationships for our Chicago headquarters team, coordinating with staff across departments and keeping the workplace running smoothly every single day.

Additional duties include scheduling, budgeting for office supplies, organizing team events, and supporting new hires with their onboarding paperwork and workspace setup in the Chicago office.
